qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the staged candidate tree 6e8f388 and serialized fix rechecks of the revised tree 7d283bd, committed signed as 41cc79e, found the original correctness, scoped-coverage, quiz-safety and comprehensibility defects resolved; consistency and scoped cross-file integration were clean throughout. 無し no longer claims that なし speaks only of absence, which contradicted its own evaluative それはなしです; it now names いいえ and いえ for negative answers, bounds the absence sense to Nなしで and Nなしの and points to the separate evaluative use. ノー and 無 restore translated versions of EN's source-provenance qualifications (no English gloss in the source row for ノー; a mismatched "nothing" gloss paired with ぶ for 無, with separate ぶ and む source rows). 現状 now excludes 様子 «положение дел; облик», as its sibling situation cards already do, and 無 excludes ノー, with which it shares the prefix title «без». 燃える uses the glossary term «итидан»; 犯罪 replaces «действенный» (effective) with «состав напоминает о действии»; 独身 renders gender-neutral 友人 as «с другом, не состоящим в браке»; and 現場 replaces the calque «передний край» with «любое место, где непосредственно идёт практическая работа». Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes, including the staged-tree review while commit signing was unavailable, are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 19 EN exclusions across 13 lists are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received 16 direct, one-sided exclusions on 10 new cards: 現状–様子; 物質–布; 物語–歴史/語る; 物事–こと/物; 燃える–焼ける; 熱中–ねっしん; 無事–大丈夫/幸福; 否–嫌; 無し–いいえ/いえ/否; 無–無し/ノー. After review, 現状–様子 and 無–ノー were added; the 無し–いいえ/いえ/否 guards were kept as conservative because Russian «нет» is also the ordinary predicate of absence. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

Mentions that EN leaves unlinked stay plain. No surrounding prose was changed. Missing kanji cards and unavailable word targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.

Its closure under the source quiz-exclusion edges is exactly the 30 requested words; nothing was added. 王→王様, 否→いえ/寧ろ, ノー→いえ/否 and 無し→ノー are the dependency edges inside the batch.

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined optional items: dropping 無し–いいえ/いえ/否 (consistency F3; kept as conservative distractor-pool loss because Russian «нет» also states absence, as the 無し body explains); an extra いやな example on 否 (the reviewer judged the passage understandable, and it would be a Russian-only Japanese example outside EN); a less technical title for 率 than «коэффициент» (the title deliberately avoids 割合 «доля; соотношение», and the body defines it); and changes to ノー «английского no» and 現場 «дзюбакоёми», which match existing cards. A guard for 父親–親 was judged unnecessary by the reviewer, because 父親's title is explicit about «отец». The optional 独身 and 現場 wording improvements were adopted. The RU-added comparison sentences are plain text because RU-only links break EN link parity. No reviewer finding remains open.
